heapOrArchives.title: Forged Activation Orders
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Choose a piece of ice. The Corp either rezzes that piece of ice or trashes it.

heapOrArchives.title: Security Code WORM Chip
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Play only if you made a successful run on HQ this turn. Trash a piece of unrezzed ice.

heapOrArchives.title: Security Code WORM Chip
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Play only if you made a successful run on HQ this turn. Trash a piece of unrezzed ice.

heapOrArchives.title: Core Command: Jettison Ice
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Play only if you made a successful run on HQ this turn. Pay the rez cost of a piece of rezzed ice to trash it.

heapOrArchives.title: Core Command: Jettison Ice
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Play only if you made a successful run on HQ this turn. Pay the rez cost of a piece of rezzed ice to trash it.

heapOrArchives.title: Social Engineering
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Hide at least 2 from your pool in your hand; the Corp then guesses how many bits you hid. If the Corp guesses correctly, lose that many bits. Otherwise, choose a data fort and a piece of ice on that fort. Then make a run on that fort, during which you automatically pass that piece of ice.

rig.title: Krash
rig.rulesText:
2 credits: Break ice subroutine.
2 credits: +1 strength.

rig.title: Broker
rig.rulesText: Each of your turns, you may take only one action to use Broker. A: Put [3] from the bank on Broker. A: Take all the bits from Broker.

ice.title: Zombie
ice.rulesText:
[Subroutine] Do 1 brain damage.
[Subroutine] Do 1 brain damage.
[Subroutine] End the run.

ice.title: Marionette
ice.rulesText: *Trash a program. *End the run. If Runner passes Marionette, pay [1], or uninstall it and store it in HQ.

root.title: Red Herrings
root.rulesText: Runner must pay [5], in addition to any other costs, to steal agendas accessed from this fort, even on the run during which Runner trashes Red Herrings.

encounteredIce.title: Marionette
encounteredIce.rulesText: *Trash a program. *End the run. If Runner passes Marionette, pay [1], or uninstall it and store it in HQ.
